_doc: Tunable thresholds for the deterministic PERT engine and escalation classifier. Harvested from pi-estimation-api/manifest.md 'Convergence Rule' and 'Escalation Classifier' sections.

openSpecLens._doc: Nearest-neighbor baseline SP is scaled up/down by this factor per effort-tier step of difference between the issue and its matched baseline (Easy=0, Medium=1, Hard=2).

brownfieldLens._doc: Pessimistic (P) = mostLikely(M) * tier multiplier, plus a flat SP delta per matched brownfield-risk label (legacy/tech-debt/deprecated/brownfield).

specKitLens._doc: Optimistic (O): if sub-task SP estimates exist, sum them (ground truth). Otherwise proxy = max(tierFloor, acceptanceCriteria.length * perAcSp).
